database_dialect: PostgreSQL 15 ephemeral local container with tmpfs storage

production_invocation.transport: SSH stdin to Docker exec; run from the audited checkout host

preconditions: Portfolio backend a292ef4 is deployed and healthy
catalog and matching functional probes are green in core_read
the frontend publication is live and its twelve windows are green
Core queues and integration outbox are drained
fail_closed_rules: an already authoritative capability is skipped
any profile override or other effective mode aborts
the final fresh read must contain only core_primary for both capabilities
both wildcard rows must carry the expected audit actor
discarded_harness_attempts: candidate config requires synthetic admin fields before imports; added only to the isolated container
full Base.metadata SQLite creation reaches an unrelated PostgreSQL INET column
single-table SQLite does not round-trip the PostgreSQL UUID wildcard on the second ORM read
conclusion: Use the PostgreSQL-validated stdin block only after every live gate is green. It uses services.routing.set_routing, never direct SQL, and is safe to repeat after a partial invocation.
